author: gyalchester
body:
Hey!

I am going to be applying for 2 positions on the social media team, Instagram and the graphic design team.

Instagram Application

Minecraft Username: Yies

Discord ID: Colby#1538

In 1 or 2 sentences, tell me who you are: My name is Pieter, i have been with the community for over 3 years now, i enjoy playing but i am very social outside of video games, i do enjoy sports quite well too.

What is your Instagram account? @pieterswrt

Have you ever marketed something using Instagram before? Yes, i had helped a friend advertise a company he is working for https://www.techflow.co/

What changes would you like to see made on the Instagram team? I would personally like to see an active team posting at least once a day on regular updates, almost some sort of "avicus news" but then also hints for updates and all these kinds of things which will both increase the player amount but also the activity of the server.

How active are you/how is your work ethic? Personally i believe that i work quite well and try to finish over a short period of time so that i have the ability to get it reviewed, looked over and all these sorts of things so that i have the lowest possibility of getting something wrong or missing out on a bit of vital information.


Graphic Team Application 

Minecraft Username: Yies

Discord ID: Colby#1538

In 1 or 2 sentences, tell me who you are: My name is Pieter, i have been with the community for over 3 years now, i enjoy playing but i am very social outside of video games, i do enjoy sports quite well too.

What program do you use to design in? I use both Adobe Photoshop and Adobe illustrator

If you have past work, please link photos or videos. I have a large amount of photos if you want any in particular contact me.

Have you ever marketed using your designing skills? No, but i hope to start doing youtube banners and profile pictures for people soon.

If yes above, please describe what you had to do and the challenges you faced. n/a

What changes would you like to see made on the Graphic Design team? I would like to see more of a high quality edits on photos, i personally am not the best at video editing but am trying to learn but in video edits i would like to see more 'smoother' transitions and to make sure that these edits/banners/photos, etc are all to the highest standard and would appeal to the viewer.

How active are you/how is your work ethic? Personally i believe that i work quite well and try to finish over a short period of time so that i have the ability to get it reviewed, looked over and all these sorts of things so that i have the lowest possibility of getting something wrong or missing out on a bit of vital information.


Thanks!

Regards,
